title: Utanga ubwenge butagira igihe
intro: Umuntu wubahwaga cyane, uzwiho ubwenge bwe bwimbitse n'inama ze z'ubwenge, yigeze gutanga inama zirenze ibisekuruza. Amagambo ye, yanditswe mu byanditswe byera, ayobora abantu ku gushima, kwihangana no kugira imyitwarire iboneye.
clues: Nagiriye umwana wanjye inama ku cyaha gikomeye kurusha ibindi: kwifatanya n'Imana.
Nigishije uburemere bw'ibikorwa, ndetse n'agaciro k'akabuto ka sinapi, n'uburyo Imana izabikuza.
Nashimagije gushimira Imana n'ababyeyi, nemera ko kurera umwana bitoroshye.
Inama zanjye zari zirimo gushyiraho isengesho, gutegeka icyiza, kubuza ikibi, no kwihanganira kwihangana ibiba ku muntu.
Igice kimwe muri Korowani cyitiriwe izina ryanjye, kirimo inyigisho zanjye n'amasomo nasangiye.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
